items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I've seen in old photographs like, say, Pops Foster

ctx.x: Oh, just more or less played my bass and get the notes and keep swinging, swinging, you know, and getting the feel. The more I played it, the more I could feel where I want to place my hands, my fingers to pluck the different strings and finger, finger the different strings.
Now, with your left hand did you use the -- now, I've seen in old photographs like, say, Pops Foster

or some of the jazz players, that instead of using the -- well, I don't know if this is exactly right, but the classical position. I've seen like jazz players where some look like they're choking the bass.
